reason: The cited evidence shows that trace interstitials (O, N) in Ti-V-Nb-Ta cause α-Ti precipitates and softening upon aging, directly contradicting the hypothesis that adding 1–3 at% interstitials improves properties. The hypothesis misrepresents this evidence as support and provides no evidence for the claimed beneficial effect in a Ti-Ni-primary system.
premises: Trace interstitial oxygen and nitrogen in Ti-V-Nb-Ta cause α-Ti precipitate formation during aging
These α-Ti precipitates are enriched in Ti, O, and N
Precipitate formation undermines interstitial solid solution strengthening and leads to softening
The proposed Ti-Ni-primary HEA will behave similarly to Ti-V-Nb-Ta regarding interstitial effects
Adding 1–3 at% O+N will improve high-temperature strength and ductility
